notes.title: The Milgram Experiment - Progress Report
notes.notes: [p]Dear players, we're writing this update, because our previous game Do Not Press The Button took a bit more time to finish than expected but in the end the game was released this year! Now we are looking forward to finishing our next big project! [/p][p]We’re hard at work on [i]The Milgram Experiment[/i], and we’re excited with how things are coming together. Development is moving steadily, and we’re pushing to make this game as intense, dark, and thought-provoking as we envisioned from the start.[/p][p][i]The Milgram Experiment[/i] is designed to challenge you on a deeper level. Through realistic, bodycam-style gameplay, you’ll be placed in situations that will test your morals, your sense of right and wrong, and how far you’re willing to go when someone in authority tells you to.[/p][p]It’s psychological, uncomfortable, and it [i]will[/i] make you question yourself.[/p][p]Thank you all for your support so far, more updates soon.[/p]
